articleTitle: Value Conflict as a Factor of Digital Discourse
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: Values are one of the most acute issues in the context of globalisation, the transformation of Western societies and the revival of the nation-state. Digital platforms play an important role in forming values. Based on three models of values prevalent in Russia, the authors attempted to analyse the discourse of the platforms Youtube, Telegram and Vk.com in order to identify the peculiarities of discursive practices related to the conflict of values.

articleTitle: The Impact of “Live Hotlines” on the Dynamics of Conflict Communications in the Digital Space
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The article considers the influence of digital live hotlines on conflict communication in the “Authority – society” system based on the example of interaction between the St. Petersburg Government and citizens. The purpose of the study is to determine the influence of live hotlines on the dynamics of conflict development in the digital space. Content analysis is used as the main research method to identify the number of references to the conflict topic in live broadcasts and further changes in the dynamics of discussing the conflict situation and, as a consequence, the reduction of social tension. The materials and comments of the official social networks of the St. Petersburg Government were used as an empirical basis. It is expected that the results of the study will reveal the positive or negative dynamics of the influence of live broadcasts on conflict communication in the sphere of relations between the authorities and society.

articleTitle: Immersive «Post-Internet» Technologies in Media Communications and Journalism
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The digital «turn» of modern media communications in marketing, advertising and PR is determined by the capabilities of visual and audiovisual information transfer technologies, which at the moment have been defined as «immersive». First of all, we are talking about immersive technologies of augmented (AR), virtual (VR) and mixed (MR) reality and 360-degree video formats. In addition, special research interest is shown in the study of digital immersive creativity on new media platforms, how much involvement in media communication increases due to it, and how it is perceived by the audience. New media platforms where immersive technologies are developing are not only social networks, applications in our mobile devices, but also ecommerce systems, as well as sites that researchers call the «Post-Internet space».Since marketing, advertising, and PR communications are currently developing in the digital media space, it is important to determine how immersive post-Internet technologies affect the transformation of marketing, advertising, and public relations in the digital environment.

articleTitle: The Problem of Communicating with Generative AI
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The paper deals with the topical issues regarding interaction between a human being and generative AI. The authors analyze the modern communication process (including the language models), find a number of tendencies (hallucinating of AI, lower content expertness and evaluation, increasing number of deep fakes, etc.), assess the efficiency of communication with voice-activated digital assistants and argue that communication possessing proficient features of “human” interaction is the most efficient one.

articleTitle: On the Issue of New Generation’s Media Consumption Specifics: Key Motives, Trends and Problematics
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The paper is focused on digital technologies influence and digital society features, key motives, trends and problematics of young generation’s media consumption. The consequences of convergence processes in the context of media products production and consumption are also studied. The significance of information at the present stage of society’s development is substantiated in the context of the structural interaction of all information elements. Predictions regarding the prospects for media consumption of new generations are also made.

articleTitle: New Media:Tools and Practices in the Field of Catering
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: With the introduction of Internet technologies into the everyday life of mankind, the methods and forms of communication are being transformed. The global network is modifying mass communications, developing virtual and augmented realities as part of a new metaverse of various organizations. The catering industry, which actively uses new digital communication tools, is no exception. The reason for this trend is high competition for the client, who, when choosing between establishments, primarily interacts with the restaurant’s digital communications. The development of new digital technologies leads to changes in the organization’s communication system with the consumer. With the widespread introduction of the concept of the experience economy, the service industry becomes hostage to the requirements of the client, who now chooses not only the product, but also additional functional characteristics. The catering sector is changing especially dramatically, from simple food outlets to new creative gastro-courts and retro pubs. The purpose of the work is to identify and systematize new media tools in the field of public catering, as well as describe and analyze the most successful practices of new media, assess the possibility of replication. Public catering enterprises of the Siberian Federal District (Novosibirsk, Barnaul, Kemerovo), as well as Moscow and St. Petersburg, were taken as the basis for empirical material. The main tools of new media were identified, a statistical analysis of their application was carried out, and a qualitative assessment of various usage practices was carried out (including through the analysis of consumer reviews). Additionally, an analysis of consumer preferences in the field of public catering was carried out regarding the choice and further interaction with food outlets. Digital transformation has led to changes in traditional communication tools. New media make it possible to improve and more effectively organize the interaction of restaurants with the audience, as well as significantly expand their customer base.

articleTitle: Transmedia Digital Communications in Public Administration System
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: In the era of total mediatization of social and political processes and the development of digital technologies, there are changes in the communications that implement these processes. Communications of public sphere actors acquire intermedial character, become transmedial. This, of course, has an impact on the nature of emerging social and political relations of public sphere actors. Therefore, the author, within the framework of the research, considers the main transformations of the system of public administration in the conditions of institutionalizing intermediality of modern media communications.The author presents transmedia communications in the article as having an intermedial character. The author defines the intermedial features of transmedia interaction of public sphere actors in the context of the study of modern media communication processes. Determination of the phenomenon of transmedia communications within the framework of intermedial studies helps to characterize the complex processes of media communication on a variety of media platforms using modern digital technologies.Thus, the author of the article pays much attention to the technologocentric approach in the study of the role of transmedia digital communications in the processes of transformation of public administration. It is important to identify the technological potential of digital media for the development of intermedial media communications and transmedia storytelling. This will be undertaken by the author in this article.

articleTitle: Digital Twins in Healthcare System: Communication between Society and Law
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The use of digital twin technology is aimed at revolutionizing the healthcare system, which would allow testing treatment with a human’s digital twin, forecasting the course of diseases, observing a body’s reaction to the medication or operation applied. This, in turn, will shape the effective level of communications between medical workers and patients. As the use of this technology is still at the initial stage of development, we should pay considerable attention to its legal regulation in order not to hinder the innovative development or establish control over it by the state, on the one hand, and – on the other hand – to prevent risks and threats from its use, to prevent and suppress illegal acts in this area, which may arise with the technology introduction, and to select the most effective model of legal regulation of such legal relations. Objective. To study possible directions of digital twins’ application in healthcare; to assess the state of legal regulation of these social relations and the level of communication between society and law, as well as to identify the risks of using digital technology in healthcare. Methods. In the research process, general scientific (analysis, synthesis, induction, deduction) and specific scientific methods of scientific cognition were used.

articleTitle: Parsing the Big Data for PR-purposes in Digital Society
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The paper aims to study the theoretical framework of big-data usage in PR as well as practical problems of parsing in digital society. Parsing is believed to be one of the main methods of big-data retrieval today. The process of parsing applies special software or programming languages’ scripts to download big-data from any web-site. The paper analyzes the parsing of the web-site for the Legislative Assembly of St Petersburg (PR-department section). The author describes limitations and advantages of parsing in PR.

articleTitle: Benefits of Applying Digital Communication Technologies in Educational Activities of Modern Universities
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The use of innovative technologies in higher education has allowed to transform the educational process. These trends require comprehensive consideration and comprehensive analysis. The goal is to identify the disadvantages and advantages of using digital technologies in the educational process. The methodology of the conducted research is a desk analysis of written studies on the topic of “digitalization of education”, as well as methods of comparative analysis and interpretation of law. According to the study results, the advantages and disadvantages of digital communication technologies application in educational activities of universities are highlighted. The advantages include: the possibility of gaining knowledge anywhere in the world; increase in the training retention factor; availability of video materials at any time; transparency of assessments; the possibility to retake tests, control tasks; mastering modern technologies; individual learning pace; minimization of costs; increase in self-motivation.

articleTitle: The Issue of Corporate Citizens Digital Communication Efficiency under the Network-Centric Governance
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The extensive penetration of digital technologies to our everyday lives through different types of digital media stimulates to apply network and media approaches to analyse the present day reality.The article methodology is based on the network approach to corporate communication structures in digital space. The empiric materials were composed by digital media materials, related to the Russian corporate citizens socially oriented activitie (collected by using BrandAnalytics digital analytical system).The period of collection: 27 November–3 December 2023, 4–10 December 2023, 11–17 December 2023.The study objective is to reveal digital media content related to corporate citizens’ discourse focusing on the digital media efficiency perspective.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence as a Driver of Strategic Communications in the Period of Deep Mediatization
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the transformation of the processes of deep mediatization of social relations in a ratified digital society, due to the intensive introduction of self-learning neural networks and, more broadly, generative artificial intelligence. The characteristic of the current stage of mediatization is given, and an overview of the relevant theoretical approaches is proposed. The influence of artificial intelligence technologies on mediatization processes is considered, positive and negative effects are identified, and the most significant risks are analyzed. Special attention is paid to such phenomena with negative potential as the deepening of the digital divide, manipulation of public opinion and its exploitation with the use of deep fakes, preservation of bubbles and echo chambers, algorithmic bias and cultural homogenization.

articleTitle: Digital Populism in Social Media
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The study is focused on populism as an effective means of increasing publicity capital in social media. The main goal of the research is to identify the role of populist rhetoric in digital communication, based on the principles of E. Laclau’s populist theory and N. Carpentier’s theory of antagonism discourse, as well as using the Engagement Rate and Engagement Rate per Reach metrics to measure the level of engagement among users with leaders’ social media content.

articleTitle: Crowdfunding as an Online Integration Platform for Social Interaction in the Digital Society
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: Crowdfunding is considered as an online technology with integration potential of social interaction in the digital society. Communication and value-based approaches were used in the research. The theoretical base is the works of Bauman Z; Kirby A.; Rafikova S. A.; Teokharova. Excpected results: to determine the integration potential of crowdfunding as well as factors blocking it.

articleTitle: Development of a Methodology for Assessing the Quality and Communication Capabilities of Government Telegram Bots
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The popularity of the Telegram messenger is growing every year, attracting a large number of users, this tool is actively used by business and the government in their communication strategies. In addition to sending messages, thanks to its flexible capabilities, Telegram allows users to create mini bot applications. Telegram bots are automated programs or scripts designed for use in the messenger. These bots allow you to interact with users and provide information or services in a convenient way. The work is devoted to the study of government Telegram bots. The analysis of the functionality of bots and their impact on improving citizens’ access to public services has been carried out. 64 bots were selected for the analysis, with a description of their main capabilities, a questionnaire was compiled to assess the quality and functionality, monitoring and rating of bots were conducted, and the possibilities of electronic participation for users were considered. The main advantages and disadvantages of bots are described. The communication possibilities and prospects of using bots as an electronic participation tool are considered. Monitoring of social networks was carried out, for discussion by citizens of Telegram bots, to assess their popularity.

articleTitle: Assessing the Impact of Digital Services on Value-based City Management
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The report presents research aimed at assessing effectiveness of the digital services’ ecosystem developed in St. Petersburg. This work is based on the results of expert survey of St. Petersburg municipalities’ representatives and their evaluation of digital services’ prioritization (101 employees from more than half of local governments are surveyed). Main concepts based on empirical research (survey, focus groups, brainstorming) are described; three types of services are identified; directions for further research are outlined. It is concluded that most of municipal servants consider digital services as an effective tool for making decisions and providing a communication with citizens.

articleTitle: Personal and Institutional Communication Strategies on Social Media
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The emergence of social media has been a major factor in the transition to the “post-truth era”. Under the conditions of Web 2.0, institutional media with traditional newsrooms have been competing with “individual reporters”, leading to the term “citizen journalism”. Personal and institutional communication strategies play an important role in shaping social media discourse. The authors conducted a comparative analysis of these strategies regarding YouTube, Telegram and Vk.com.

articleTitle: Professional Communication between Patients and Doctors When Using Augmented Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The publication investigates the application of innovative technologies, including augmented reality, in medical sphere. The issues of human rights regulation protection in this field are relevant. The article draws attention to technologies application in research, in the training of medical professionals, and in everyday medical procedures such as therapy, rehabilitation, psychotherapy, and surgery. The authors establish the peculiarity of using augmented reality in medicine during professional communication between doctors and patients stating that it must meet certain standards. The safety problems and ethical aspects are crucial in the use of augmented reality technologies. Issues of doctor-patient relations, privacy and data protection are raised, as well as those of fairness and equal access, liability and safety concerns. The authors suggest strategies to mitigate potential adverse effects and propose regulation to define standards for the use of augmented reality while respecting human dignity and fundamental rights. Objective. To investigate the consequences of the augmented reality technology use in professional communication between doctors and patients; to determine how to prevent negative consequences and ensure equal access to quality healthcare. Methods. The methods used in the research include general scientific (such as analysis, synthesis, induction, deduction) and specific scientific cognition methods.

articleTitle: Media Literacy and AI-technologies in Digital Communication: opportunities and Risks
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The paper aims to study the opportunities and risks that artificial intelligence technologies pose for digital communication. Authors argue that media literacy approach has valuable potential in the field. To support this opinion the meta-analysis of scientific articles within the Google Scholar platform for the period from 2020 to 2023 in Russian and English has been developed. It has been found that among scientist there is common to treat as risks of AI-technologies two things: mental health and fake-news. The positive treats are given to the AI having more of routine tasks which, in general, allowed people to unload for more complex and creative tasks. More people will be involved both in communication with AI and using its products as part of their strategic communications. That is why it is pointless to fight AI. It would be more appropriate to teach people how to use AI and to understand what consequences this can lead to.

articleTitle: The Power of Digital Platforms in Journalism: Strategies and Practices for Adapting Content in TikTok
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The article uses the example of short videos in TikTok to examine the changes in the principles of news content distribution due to the emergence of new communication platforms. From the perspectives of news gathering and news value, we conducted a manual content analysis of Belarusian media to reveal the commonalities and heterogeneities of their news production on TikTok. It is determined what new means of content promotion in social networks are used by the studied media. The most effective communication strategies of media production are identified, taking into account audience demands and the logic of the recommendation platform. The main features of such a format as «short video» intended for distribution on social media platforms are established. The increasing influence of content recommendation platforms on publishers and their audience is discussed. The authors conclude on the growing dominance of global technology platforms over journalism.

articleTitle: AI for Tainment Communications: Potential and Pitfalls
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: Tainment communications encompass various technologies for news, content and key data transmitting, thus transforming the relationship between facts consuming, learning and play. Personalization trend in communications, the development of technologies of big data, artificial intelligence (AI), and machine learning transform the communication sphere and contribute to media development optimization, content diversification and polycoding, offering the most engaging tainment materials to target audiences. The analysis of secondary data, the results of the survey of content ultimate consumers and the expert interview revealed the potentials and pitfalls of AI in tainment communications. The pitfalls of further leverage of AI for content creation include limited creativity, shortfall of emotions and empathy, as the context of taintment content is yet incomprehensible to AI. Irrelevant or improper filling of AI-generated content is the main issue related to its leverage in communication and marketing. As students are the main consumers of tainment communications, the results of the survey show the main applications of AI to the content creation.

Author Keywords: issues and opportunities of tainment communications

articleTitle: Digital Brand Reputation Management to Promote Goods on Internet Platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the consideration of technologies and methods of reputation management in the digital environment. The development of Internet communications, in which online brand reputation plays a key role, determines the need for a timely reputation audit followed by the development of a comprehensive strategy for brand reputation management for the long term. At the same time, reputation management is interpreted as a social and communicative technology. On the basis of a system-productive approach, the authors identified the main tools of reputation management on the Internet. They are given recommendations on the organization of analytical work for more effective brand promotion in the digital environment and on marketplaces.

articleTitle: Eye-Tracking Study into Patterns of Attention to Environmental Media Texts among Youth Audiences in the Context of the Communicative Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The paper uses eye-tracking technologies to present the results of analyzing the patterns of attention to environmental media texts in mass media and social media of industrial regions among three groups of respondents (aged 18-21 years old, 22-25 years old, 26-30 years old). The research covered a sample of 102 environmental media texts selected from the mass media and social media of the cities of the Chelyabinsk region and Yekaterinburg. Eye-tracking technologies used video recording to register the eye movements of the audience when reading media texts and to generate heat maps providing a graphical representation of data and attention patterns. The analysis results showed that “Z”, “F”, and “spotted” patterns prevail among the respondents.

articleTitle: Features of Communication of the Chairmen of Regional Public Chambers on the VKontakte Social Network Site
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: Digital communications play an important role in modern society, having a significant impact on various aspects of people’s lives. Social media communication allows community leaders to promote their ideas, draw attention to their activities and ongoing projects, and receive feedback from citizens. The paper examines the peculiarities of communication between the chairmen of regional public chambers on the VKontakte social network, as the most numerous in terms of the number of users in our country. The Public Chamber is a public advisory body established to ensure interaction between citizens and authorities. Research methods: analysis of 30 pages of chairmen of public chambers of the regions of Russia, selected using a randomizer, on the VKontakte social network. Digital communications provide chairmen of public chambers with an effective tool to promote their messages and values, establish contact with the audience and draw attention to the broadcast agendas. The study revealed the main broadcast thematic agendas, features of content and page formats in the selected social network.

articleTitle: The Digital Transition of Local Newspapers: New Communication Strategies for Audience Retention
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: Most studies on the changes that media are undergoing in the digital age have focused on large markets. However, local journalism has received relatively little attention in these studies, despite the fact that the sector is undergoing fundamental changes. This article explores new tools for keeping audience attention in digital journalism. Based on 50 expert interviews with media executives in Russia and Belarus, the main directions of transformation of local media communication strategies in the digital society are identified. It is concluded that increased competition for audience attention in some cases leads to the tabloidization of formats and styles of news presentation. Among the features of local journalism focused on digital society and technology, the growing role of the audience, the dominance of visual content, and the diversification of distribution channels are highlighted. The study identifies and characterizes the main tools to increase audience engagement, and proposes criteria for effective distribution of media texts. It is concluded that the need to build and maintain relationships with the audience is the most important factor in the development of digital journalism.

articleTitle: Social Rating as a New Form of Communication in the Digital Space
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: Digitalization of various aspects of life makes it possible to accumulate large amounts of digitized data about citizens. This allows to rank individuals according to various criteria. Many companies have started to create their own internal ratings, as well as user and customer ratings. In fact, ratings can be perceived as a form of communication between the evaluator and the evaluated, but the rules of interaction are dictated most often only by one of the parties.The paper presents the results of a survey of experts and 3 focus groups of different age categories of the population (youth, middle age and the older generation). The purpose of the article is to identify the features of social rating, its problems and prospects in the context of rapid digitalization of human life. Rating determines not only the position of a person in the coordinate system of assessment, but also the very form of communication.Rating systems can be used to evaluate people’s social behavior, as well as to provide access or create restrictions on the allocation of resources. To date, the nature of the development of social rating systems is determined by business and government agencies, while commercial enterprises have already succeeded with large-scale testing of customer and employee assessment systems. Citizens, on the other hand, become forced participants in rating systems due to the need to obtain the desired services. The positive side of rating is manifested in the simplification of communication between people and the emergence of new mechanisms of social interaction, manifested, among other things, in the expansion of potentially available services. The negative side lies in the potential formation of problems and threats to the introduction of a social rating system, ranging from increased social stratification to restrictions on citizens’ freedoms. One way or another, rating is a powerful tool for influencing communication between actors of social relations.

articleTitle: Specifics of Hybrid Communications in the Digital Space
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The article is devoted to identifying the specifics of integrated communications in the digital space. The theoretical reflection of the concept of hybrid communications in digital environment is based on the work of foreign and Russian researchers. It is argued that the integrated use of channels of interaction with the consumer is a powerful driver for achieving a synergistic effect in communications for an intentional impact on the target audience. The authors describe the main methods, opportunities and ways of implementing integrated communications in a digital environment. Based on the modeling method, the stages of the hybrid communications strategy in the Internet context are presented. At each stage, resources and tools have been selected and systematized to allow mobile adjustment and optimization of the marketing program. In the course of the study, it was found that today traditional communications are inferior to digital ones in their potential opportunities that they can provide to companies. It is revealed the nomenclature of the most common tools of integrated communications in the digital space and examples of their implementation are given. The authors expand the concept of “integrated communications” to the concept of “hybrid communications”, which means synchronous and asynchronous formats of brand interaction with the consumer based on the transformation of communication strategy in the modern digital space

articleTitle: Corporations’ Digital Rating Systems and their Perception by Audience
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: Social rating is a new type of digital communication between actors entering into different forms of interaction. At the same time, corporations accumulate a large amount of data about their customers in digital format, which allows them to carry out customer ratings. The understanding and development of rating systems is associated with the increasing importance of information and communication technologies, digital platforms and ecosystems in our lives. The issues of the real impact of ratings and their social consequences are becoming relevant. In this article, social rating in communication is presented as a system for evaluating and ranking people according to their social actions, as well as ways of feedback from the actors of these interactions. The purpose of the study was to evaluate existing social rating systems as a form of communication between their creators (organizations) and customers and users.Research methods: focus group and experiment on communication with organizations engaged in rating citizens.The study demonstrates the actual lack of interest and proactive position on issues of communication between citizens and the creators of ratings, the desire to find out their rating and attempts to influence it. Not all organizations that carry out social rating of citizens demonstrate readiness for communication, openness of methods and disclosure of potential consequences of rating, thereby showing inequality in communication between the interacting parties. Thus, we can say that social rating is a new format of digital communication, which will develop rapidly in the near future.

articleTitle: Analysis of Ethical Risks in Interactions within Professional Networking Communities for Helping Professionals
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The paper explores the ethical risks associated with the practices of online psychologists within a professional network community, utilizing an automated method of data collection and speech intention analysis. The automated content analysis provided a description of the characteristics of digital assistance discourse and the ethical dilemmas it entails, such as the inevitable multiple relationships, blurred professional boundaries, and breaches of confidentiality. The virtual self-presentations of psychologists were assessed in line with current ethical codes, leading to the identification of ethical risks associated with the use of manipulative and suggestive speech techniques. The practical significance of the findings lies in their potential application across various areas including the development of tools for analyzing and monitoring professional psychological communication on the Internet, the establishment of professional communication standards to ensure the safety of potential clients within online psychological communities, and deontological regulation in accordance with the ethical norms of the psychologists’ association to which the specialist belongs.

articleTitle: Main Directions for Improving the Online Reputation of Technical Universities
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The increased demand for technical education has intensified competition between universities to attract students. Reputation is a critical factor in winning this competition. COVID-19 has accelerated the digitization of all aspects of social life. One of the consequences has been a shift in public attention to the online environment, which has become stakeholders’ main source of information about universities. Currently, the digital space is becoming a platform for building trusting and transparent relationships with different groups of university stakeholders. Therefore, effective reputation management of educational institutions in the online environment is of particular importance. It should be noted that there may be a discrepancy between the reputation of the university in the eyes of its target audiences. Taking this into account, as well as the specificities of online communication, it is logical to use different criteria for different stakeholders when assessing the results of the university’s reputation-building activities. This study shows that the online reputation of technical areas in universities depends primarily on the complex content that can be found on the Internet and the demonstration of the intangible assets/values of both the university as a whole and a particular area, which form the reputational capital. The article presents the results of an analysis of the communication activities of technical universities and identifies trends in the online promotion of educational institutions. The analysis is based on the monitoring of publications using the media database of the Medialogy and the Brand Analitics platforms. The study also included rankings, which are one of the most important sources of reputation information.

articleTitle: Perception of Political Information in Online Communication on the Social Network VKontakte: Features of Content Consumption by Student Representatives
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: Social network sites act as a platform for communication between political actors and their audience. The actors broadcast their position and value judgments in order to form public opinion, gain support and provoke appropriate actions from the target audience. The digital communication strategies used by political actors are based on several principles: remoteness from the recipient of information, suggestibility and constant change of visual content, which allows maintaining communication between the supplier and consumer of content for a long period, the speed of information dissemination between both donors and recipients. Thus, the effectiveness of digital communication between politicians and students through blogging and the linguistic categories used by political actors in communication strategies will be evaluated. The paper will present the results of a content analysis of the posts of the leaders of three political parties- United Russia, LDPR and Just Russia- Patriots- for the Truth (due to the lack of an empirical base for others) about the presidential elections in Russia in March 2024, posted in the official groups of the parties on the Vkontakte), as well as in-depth interviews and questionnaires of students in order to identify their perception and reaction to these posts. Thus, the semantic structure directed by a political entity with an assessment of elections, as well as their perception by students (using the example of students of Yaroslavl State University named after P.G. Demidov) and students’ vision of political digital communication strategies among representatives of three parties will be evaluated.

articleTitle: Communication Strategies for the Competition of the Show Business Actors in the Digital Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the description of the specifics of competition in show business. The aim is to identify the communicative strategies, tactics and techniques used by the “stars’’ of show business to fight rivals, and analyze the features of their implementation in digital media in a crisis event. The research material includes posts by celebrities in the TOP 30 on demand in the TG-Stat service, published in the Telegram messenger after the scandalous party of blogger A. Ivleeva with the dress code “almost naked as well as publications by some show business personalities on other social networks. As a result of the study, the use of two strategies of competition between the “stars’’ of show business was discovered: offensive (attacking) and defensive. As part of the offensive strategy, the following tactics were identified: tactics of discrediting competitors, tactics of manipulating public consciousness and tactics of mythologization. The defensive strategy in show business is represented by tactics such as explaining/explaining the situation, deflecting criticism from oneself, self-presentation and apology. The analysis of empirical material showed that the offensive strategy as a tool of competition with rivals was mainly used by show business actors who were not present at the scandalous event, and the defensive strategy was used by those “stars’’ who became participants in the “naked’’ party and received public condemnation. Taking into account the fact that the spheres of politics and show business have many common features (for example, the desire to compete with rivals for leadership, the desire for entertainment communication, manipulative influence on the audience, etc.), the authors of the article hypothesize that communication strategies of competition in politics and showbusiness may coincide.
